listening.title: Nam discusses his pay review with HR

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: Hi Nam, thanks for coming. Today we can talk about your pay review for this year.

lines.speaker: Nam (Backend Developer)
lines.text: Thank you, Hoa. I prepared a short list of what I delivered in the last six months.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: Great. Your team lead already told me you fixed the payment service and trained two juniors.

lines.speaker: Nam (Backend Developer)
lines.text: Yes. Because of that, I would like to ask for a pay rise of about twelve percent.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: I understand. Right now the company can approve eight percent on your gross salary.

lines.speaker: Nam (Backend Developer)
lines.text: Can I ask what my net salary will be after tax and insurance?

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: I will send you the exact number by email tomorrow morning, with the full remuneration package.

lines.speaker: Nam (Backend Developer)
lines.text: That helps. Besides salary, are there any fringe benefits for the technical team this year?

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: Yes, we added a health check for your family and a budget for cloud certificates.

lines.speaker: Nam (Backend Developer)
lines.text: That sounds fair. Could we also review my level again in six months?

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: Of course. I will note it down and we will talk again in March.
